arguments.message: Validated scatter plot of enrollment (y-axis) against study duration in days (x-axis), calculated as completion date minus start date. Only records with day-level precision for both dates were plotted; records with month-only dates were excluded, with no date or enrollment imputation. No records had missing enrollment. The accompanying result reports the plotted population and exclusions. Day-level precision does not necessarily mean an actual date: registry dates marked estimated or unspecified remain eligible and are distinguished in the plot data. Duration represents the overall study period, not an individual participant’s treatment duration.
